dedupe_keys.name: emisi project 4 wastewater treatment plants and 2 faecal sludge treatment plans two seasons nitrous oxide dataset

description: The EMISI consortium publishes nitrous-oxide measurements for four wastewater-treatment plants and two faecal-sludge treatment plants in Indonesia. Zenodo supplies an Excel workbook free under CC BY 4.0. Sites are identified in Jakarta, Balikpapan and Labuan Bajo, and the title describes measurements over two seasons. These observations can inform greenhouse-gas emission factors and process simulations for sanitation infrastructure. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this six-facility collection. Coverage is the selected facilities and campaigns, not a national plant inventory. The long contributor list establishes field collaboration but does not define sampling dates, operating states, units or analytical uncertainty. Seasonal comparison requires comparable plant conditions and sampling effort, which the public description does not specify. No workbook was downloaded or emission factor recalculated.
